summary: Tested 'Stats Only' mode feature for live scoring. All 7 features verified and working correctly: 3-column ScoringSelector grid, Stats Only mode entry with clocks OFF, header Stats Only button toggle, amber/gray highlighting, and independent clock toggle compatibility.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stats Only mode feature fully tested. ScoringSelector shows 3 options in 3-column grid. Stats Only button in header toggles both clocks and uses amber color when active. Login via API, store user object from response.data.user in localStorage as 'mlbl_current_user'. To access ScoringSelector: Events & Schedule -> click button[title='Enter Scores'] on a game event row.

scoring_selector_3_options.details: ScoringSelector shows 3 options: Live Stats Entry, Stats Only, Quick Score Entry in a 3-column grid (md:grid-cols-3)

stats_only_from_selector.details: Clicking Stats Only card + Start opens EnhancedLiveStatsEntry with both clocks OFF (game clock shows '--:--', no Start/Pause/Next Quarter buttons)

stats_only_button_in_header.details: Stats Only button exists in sticky header next to Clock/Shot toggles with data-testid='stats-only-btn'

stats_only_button_toggle_on.details: Clicking Stats Only in header disables both toggles and switches tab to home stats

stats_only_button_toggle_off.details: Clicking Stats Only again re-enables both clocks (acts as a toggle)

stats_only_button_highlighting.details: When Stats Only active: bg-amber-500 text-white (amber). When inactive: bg-gray-700 text-gray-300 (gray)

independent_clock_toggles.details: Game clock and shot clock toggles still work independently. Stats Only button reflects state (amber only when BOTH clocks off)
